title: Search components with page-local medium counts
description: Search and paginate by name or GMO ID before counting direct medium usages for the selected page. Return conditional Role and Property facet counts.

name.description: Case-insensitive literal substring of a preferred or alternative name. Empty means no name filter.

role_id.description: Role GMO ID, including all descendant Roles. Empty means no Role filter. Role facet counts ignore this parameter.

property_id.description: Directly assigned Property GMO ID. Empty means no Property filter. Property facet counts ignore this parameter.

sort.description: Sort by preferred name or GMO ID. Sorting by medium_count is not supported.

order.description: Sort direction: asc for ascending or desc for descending.

limit.description: Maximum number of components to return. Use a non-negative safe integer; 0 returns an empty list.

offset.description: Number of components to skip. Use a non-negative safe integer.
